blocks.text: Patrick Garcia finally addressed claims that he abandoned his former girlfriend, Jennylyn Mercado, during her pregnancy with their child, asserting it was the actress who supposedly did not want him to be involved at the time. Garcia broke his silence through an interview with Ogie Diaz, which was shared on the latter’s YouTube channel on Tuesday, Sept. 29. The actor delved into the topic as he spoke about being a father to his five children—Jazz, his son with Jennylyn; and Michelle Celeste, Nicola Patrice, Francisca Pia and Enrique whom he shares with his wife, Nikka Martinez. “With the four kids with […]...
